statement: Enumerate valid hours and minutes matching the wildcard pattern.
approach_name: Count wildcard-compatible hours and minutes

title: Number of Valid Clock Times
statement: Enumerate valid hours and minutes matching the wildcard pattern.
approach_name: Count wildcard-compatible hours and minutes
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int countTime(String time){String[] p=time.split(":");int h=0,m=0;for(int i=0;i<24;i++){String s=String.format("%02d",i);if((p[0].charAt(0)=='?'||p[0].charAt(0)==s.charAt(0))&&(p[0].charAt(1)=='?'||p[0].charAt(1)==s.charAt(1)))h++;}for(int i=0;i<60;i++){String s=String.format("%02d",i);if((p[1].charAt(0)=='?'||p[1].charAt(0)==s.charAt(0))&&(p[1].charAt(1)=='?'||p[1].charAt(1)==s.charAt(1)))m++;}return h*m;} }

class Solution { public int findMaxK(int[] nums){Set<Integer>s=new HashSet<>();for(int x:nums)s.add(x);int best=-1;for(int x:s)if(x>0&&s.contains(-x))best=Math.max(best,x);return best;} }

title: Odd String Difference
statement: Compare adjacent-character difference signatures.
approach_name: Identify the unique adjacent-character difference signature
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String oddString(String[] words){Map<String,Integer> f=new HashMap<>();for(String w:words)f.merge(sig(w),1,Integer::sum);for(String w:words)if(f.get(sig(w))==1)return w;return "";} private String sig(String w){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(int i=1;i<w.length();i++)b.append((int)w.charAt(i)-(int)w.charAt(i-1)).append(',');return b.toString();} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] applyOperations(int[] nums){int[] a=nums.clone();for(int i=0;i<a.length-1;i++)if(a[i]==a[i+1]){a[i]*=2;a[i+1]=0;}int[] out=new int[a.length];int j=0;for(int x:a)if(x!=0)out[j++]=x;return out;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int distinctAverages(int[] nums){int[] a=nums.clone();Arrays.sort(a);Set<Integer>s=new HashSet<>();for(int i=0;i<a.length/2;i++)s.add(a[i]+a[a.length-1-i]);return s.size();} }

approach_name: Count index triples with pairwise distinct values
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int unequalTriplets(int[] nums){int c=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<nums.length;j++)for(int k=j+1;k<nums.length;k++)if(nums[i]!=nums[j]&&nums[i]!=nums[k]&&nums[j]!=nums[k])c++;return c;} }

title: Find the Pivot Integer
statement: Compare prefix sum with total triangular sum.
approach_name: Find an integer square root of the triangular sum
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int pivotInteger(int n){int total=n*(n+1)/2;int x=(int)Math.sqrt(total);return x*x==total?x:-1;} }

approach_name: Check neighboring word endpoints in a cycle
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean isCircularSentence(String sentence){String[] w=sentence.split(" ");for(int i=0;i<w.length;i++)if(w[i].charAt(w[i].length()-1)!=w[(i+1)%w.length].charAt(0))return false;return true;} }
